div.head: II Eg 3.1
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hwa þonne ða teoðunge gelæstan nelle, swa we gecwedan habbað, fare þæs cynges gerefa tó ⁊ þæs biscopes ⁊ þæs mynstres mæssepreost, ⁊ niman unþances þæne teoðan dæl to þam mynstre, þe hit togebyrige, ⁊ tæcan him to ðam nigeðan dæle; ⁊ todæle man þa eahta dælas on twá, ⁊ fó se landhlaford to ealfan, to ealfan se biscop, sy hit cynges man, sy hit þegnes.

⁊ gyf hwa þonne ða teoðunge gelæstan nelle, swa we gecweden habbað, fare þæs cinges gerefa to ⁊ þæs bisceopes ⁊ þæs mynstres mæssepreost, ⁊ niman únþances ðæne teoðan dæl to þam mynstre, ðe hit tobyrge, ⁊ tæcan him to þam nygoþan dæle; ⁊ todæle man þa eahta dælas on twa, ⁊ fó se landhlaford to healfum, to healfan se bisceop, sy hit cynges man, sy hit þegnes.

Si quis decimam dare nolit sicut diximus, adeat prepositus regis et episcopi et sacerdos illius ecclesie, et reddant ecclesie cui pertinebit decimam suam, et nonam partem dimittant ei qui decimam suam detinuit; et VIII partes in duo diuidantur, dimidium domino, dimidium episcopo, sit homo regis, sit homo taini.

Gif hwa þonne ða teoðunge gelæstan nelle, swa we gecweden habbað, þonne fare þæs cyninges gerefa to ⁊ þæs biscopes ⁊ þæs mynstres mæssepreost ⁊ niman unðances þone teoðan dæl to þam mynstre ðe hit togebirige, ⁊ tæcan him to ðam nigoðan dæle, ⁊ todæle man ða eahta dælas on twa, ⁊ fo se landhlaford to healfum, to healfum se biscop, si hit cyninges man si hit þegnes.

And gyf hwa þonne ða teoðunge gelæstan nelle, swa we gecwedan habbað, fare þæs cynges gerefa to and þæs biscopes and þæs mynstres mæssepreost, and niman unþances þæne teoðan dæl to þam mynstre, þe hit togebyrige, and tæcan him to ðam nigeðan dæle. And todæle man þa eahta dælas on twa, and fo se landhlaford to healfan, to healfan se biscop, sy hit cynges man, sy hit þegnes.

If, however, anyone refuses to render tithes in accordance with what we have decreed, the king's reeve, and the bishop's reeve, and the priest of the church shall go to him, and, without his consent, shall take the tenth part for the church to which it is due, and the next tenth shall be allotted to him, and the eight [remaining] parts shall be divided in two, and the lord of the manor shall take half and the bishop half, whether the man be under the lordship of the king or of a thegn.

And if someone refuses to pay the tithes, just as we have commanded, then the king’s reeve, the bishop’s reeve, and the priest of the church are to go to him and, without his consent, seize the tenth part for the church to which it is owed, and the ninth share shall be reserved for him. Let the other eight parts be divided in two, and his lord take half and the bishop half, whether he be a king’s man or a thane’s.

And if then anyone will not render the tithes, as we have decreed, the king’s reeve is to go there, and the bishop’s reeve and the mass-priest of the minster, and they are to seize without his consent the tenth part for the minster to which it belongs, and to assign to him the next tenth; and the [remaining] eight parts are to be divided into two, and the lord of the estate is to succeed to half and the bishop to half, whether it be a king’s man or a thegn’s.

Und wenn nun Einer die Zehnten, so wie wir verordnet haben, zu leisten sich weigert, (dann D) ziehe [zu ihm] hin der Vogt des Königs und [der] des Bischofs und der Pfarrer der [berechtigten] Kirche, und [sie] nehmen für diese Kirche, der es zukommt, den Zehnten gegen seinen Willen fort und weisen ihn zum neunten Zehntel; und vertheile man die [übrigen] acht Zehntel in zwei [Hälften], und ergreife der Grund-[Immunitäts]herr die Hälfte, die Hälfte der Bischof, sei es [der Weigerer] ein Vasall des Königs, sei es eines Adligen.

And if anyone then refuses to pay the tithes as we have ordained, (then, D) let the king's reeve and the bishop's [reeve] and the priest of the [entitled] minster go [to him], and [they are to] take the tenth part against his will for the minster to which it belongs, and assign him the ninth part; and let the [remaining] eight parts be divided in two, and let the [immunity-]landlord take half, the bishop half, whether [the refuser] is the king's man or a thegn's.

note.label: materializes warning of
note.quote: these included materialization of Æthelstan's warning that witholders of tenth parts risked losing the other nine

note.label: develops
note.quote: Of special interest is the relationship between Æthelstan's warning of what would happen to non-payers (1) and the penalty devised for them by Edgar (3)

div.note: In G, ‘h’ was later added before ‘ealfan’ (twice).
This code is the first to pronounce legal penalties for non-payment of tithe.
fare: þonne fare D healfan: here and subsequently in G1, ealfan has been corrected to healfan in a later (possibly Wulfstan’s?) hand
